title: First-person tank warfare in the wireframe zone: pick a chassis, choose a mode, and deploy.
author: TheMartian-Mars
selftext:
Vector Siege is a first-person tank shooter set in a glowing wireframe zone, drawn in neon lines on black.

Choose your battle mode: Team 5 v 5 (you plus 4 allies against 5 enemies), Solo Free-for-All, Capture Zones, King of the Hill, Payload or the online versions of them. You can also make custom games. Then pick a chassis, each with its own HP, armor and speed:





Striker (damage): a fast hunter with a rapid-fire laser and boost dash



Hammer (damage): a heavy cannon that cracks armor, plus boost dash



Mortar (damage): an artillery expert that shells enemies behind cover



Bulwark (tank): massive armor and a Fortify shield to shrug off fire



Mender (support): tosses health and armor packs for the team

Paint your tank in one of ten neon colors, set the match length to 3, 5 or 8 minutes, and hit Deploy.

Controls are classic FPS: WASD to drive and strafe, mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to zoom, 1/2/3 or the wheel to swap between laser, cannon and artillery, E for your chassis ability, Q for the Mender's armor pack, Space to hop and Tab for scores.

Play it free in your browser: https://tesana.com/game/vector-siege-1a58b1a6
